scope: Native/helper diagnostic and configuration disclosure boundaries, default Native feature graph, future software/process test proposal

recommendation: Closed bounded Native/helper export projection; optional public-only config summary behind existing secure feature; no raw Doctor/Status/device/config dump or new helper permission

Startup credential loaders require the actual broker UID and read private key bytes
New cancellation/reap and stdout/file publication promises need explicit owned behavior rather than stronger claims over doctor kill_on_drop
existing_evidence_scope: Named existing source fixtures reviewed only; historical software/QEMU results were not rerun or reassigned
limitations: No runtime observations in this task
No remote authentication, encryption, reachability or hardware proof
Root read-only Status may be denied by current policy; do not bypass it
No claim of zero filesystem writes: normal CLI/helper logging may occur
